title: Reading for Exams
ringkas: Strategi soal bacaan: main idea, inference, dan reference
goals: mengenali jenis soal bacaan: **main idea**, **detail**, **reference**, **vocabulary in context**, **inference**, **purpose**, dan **tone**
menjawab soal **true / false / not given** dan soal kesimpulan
menentukan **tujuan penulis** (to inform, to persuade, to entertain, to explain)
membaca teks pendek bergaya ujian dan menjawab soalnya dengan cepat
mengelola waktu saat mengerjakan soal bacaan

lesson.text: Soal bacaan hampir selalu muncul dalam ujian akhir. Kuncinya bukan membaca lebih keras, melainkan **membaca dengan strategi**: tahu jenis soal, tahu di mana mencari jawaban, dan tahu cara menyingkirkan pilihan yang salah.

lesson.title: 1. Jenis soal bacaan
table: [[What is the text about?]] / [[The main idea of paragraph 2 is ...]]
scan kata kunci, cocokkan dengan teks
cari kata benda terdekat sebelum kata itu
[[The word 'huge' is closest in meaning to ...]]
[[What can be inferred from the text?]]
simpulkan dari fakta, bukan dari dugaan

lesson.title: Jebakan umum
lesson.text: Pilihan yang memuat kata-kata persis dari teks belum tentu benar. Waspadai kata ekstrem seperti [[always]], [[never]], [[all]], [[only]]. Jawab dari **isi teks**, bukan dari pengetahuanmu sendiri.

lines.en: Many teenagers stay up late to study or play games. However, doctors say that teenagers need eight to ten hours of sleep every night.
lines.id: Banyak remaja begadang untuk belajar atau bermain game. Namun, dokter mengatakan remaja membutuhkan delapan sampai sepuluh jam tidur setiap malam.

lines.en: Sleep helps the brain to store what we learn. Students who sleep well usually concentrate better and get better marks. On the other hand, tired students often make mistakes.
lines.id: Tidur membantu otak menyimpan apa yang kita pelajari. Siswa yang tidur cukup biasanya lebih fokus dan mendapat nilai lebih baik. Sebaliknya, siswa yang lelah sering membuat kesalahan.

lines.en: Therefore, schools should start later in the morning, and students should put their phones away one hour before bedtime.
lines.id: Karena itu, sekolah seharusnya mulai lebih siang, dan siswa sebaiknya menyingkirkan ponsel satu jam sebelum tidur.

lines.en: LIBRARY NOTICE. From 1 June, the library will open at 7 a.m. and close at 4 p.m. on weekdays. It will be closed on weekends. Students can borrow up to three books for two weeks.
lines.id: PENGUMUMAN PERPUSTAKAAN. Mulai 1 Juni, perpustakaan buka pukul 7 pagi dan tutup pukul 4 sore pada hari kerja. Perpustakaan tutup pada akhir pekan. Siswa dapat meminjam hingga tiga buku selama dua minggu.

lines.en: What is the main idea of the text about sleep, Tom?
lines.id: Apa ide pokok teks tentang tidur, Tom?

lines.en: Teenagers need enough sleep, so they can learn better.
lines.id: Remaja butuh tidur cukup agar dapat belajar lebih baik.

lines.en: Good. What is the writer's purpose?
To persuade, because the writer gives opinions with the word 'should'.
lines.id: Untuk meyakinkan, karena penulis memberi pendapat dengan kata 'should'.

lesson.title: Mengelola waktu
lesson.text: Jika satu soal terlalu sulit, **lewati** dulu dan kembali nanti. Beri sekitar 1 menit per soal bacaan. Selalu sisakan 5 menit di akhir untuk memeriksa ulang.

Urutan: baca soal → skim → scan → eliminasi → cek ulang.
Tujuan penulis: **inform, persuade, entertain, instruct, describe**.
Jawab dari **isi teks**, bukan pengetahuan sendiri.

read.id:
Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, kendaraan listrik semakin populer di seluruh dunia. Tidak seperti mobil konvensional, kendaraan listrik berjalan dengan baterai, bukan bensin, sehingga tidak menghasilkan asap knalpot. Ini menjadikannya pilihan yang lebih bersih untuk kota-kota padat.
Meskipun demikian, kendaraan listrik masih menghadapi beberapa tantangan. Harganya umumnya lebih mahal daripada mobil bensin, dan stasiun pengisian terbatas di banyak daerah. Para ahli yakin bahwa masalah ini akan berangsur hilang seiring berkembangnya teknologi dan turunnya biaya produksi.

qs.exp: Ide pokok: EV populer dan punya tantangan.
options: EVs are popular but still face challenges.
Petrol cars are better than EVs in every way.
EVs are cheap and have charging stations everywhere.
Batteries are dangerous, so EVs will disappear.

options: Too many fumes from the exhaust pipe
They still need petrol to run
qs.q: Which is a challenge for EVs?

read.text:
In recent years, electric vehicles (EVs) have become increasingly popular around the world. Unlike conventional cars, EVs run on batteries instead of petrol, so they produce no exhaust fumes. This makes them a cleaner choice for crowded cities.
Nevertheless, EVs still face several challenges. They are generally more expensive than petrol cars, and charging stations are limited in many areas. Experts believe that these problems will gradually disappear as technology develops and production costs fall.
read.title: The Rise of Electric Vehicles

Para ilmuwan masih belum sepenuhnya memahami mengapa orang bermimpi, tetapi ada beberapa teori. Satu teori menyatakan bahwa mimpi membantu otak menata ingatan dari hari itu. Teori lain menyatakan bahwa mimpi memungkinkan kita berlatih menghadapi ancaman dalam situasi yang aman.
Mimpi biasanya terjadi selama tidur REM, ketika mata bergerak cepat di bawah kelopak mata. Kebanyakan orang melupakan mimpinya segera setelah bangun. Namun, menuliskannya segera dapat membantu mengingatnya lebih baik.

options: They help the brain organize memories.
They predict the future for the dreamer.
They make us sleep longer at night.
They are caused by the food we eat before bed.
qs.q: What does one theory say about dreams?

qs.exp: Konteks: "Dreams usually occur during REM sleep" = terjadi.
qs.q: What does "occur" mean in the text?

options: Sleep less so that you wake up more often
Drink coffee before going to bed
Avoid sleeping and keep a notebook
qs.q: How can you remember dreams better?

read.text:
Scientists still do not fully understand why people dream, but there are several theories. One theory suggests that dreams help the brain organize memories from the day. Another claims that dreams allow us to practise dealing with threats in a safe situation.
Dreams usually occur during REM sleep, when the eyes move quickly under the eyelids. Most people forget their dreams soon after waking up. However, writing them down immediately can help you remember them better.
read.title: Why Do We Dream?

read.focus: Bacaan: past simple dan past perfect
read.id:
Pada 1968, seorang ilmuwan di sebuah perusahaan di Amerika mencoba menciptakan lem yang sangat kuat. Sebaliknya, dia menciptakan lem lemah yang menempel pada kertas tetapi mudah dilepas. Saat itu, tidak ada yang tahu cara memakainya, jadi penemuan itu disimpan.
Beberapa tahun kemudian, karyawan lain punya masalah. Dia bernyanyi di paduan suara gereja, dan potongan kertas yang dipakainya untuk menandai bukunya terus jatuh. Lalu dia teringat lem yang lemah itu. Pada 1980, kertas tempel telah menjadi produk terkenal yang dipakai orang di seluruh dunia setiap hari.

qs.exp: Teks: "tried to invent a very strong glue".
qs.q: What did the scientist want to invent?

qs.exp: Teks: "nobody knew how to use it".
options: Nobody knew how to use it.
It was too expensive for most companies.
It was dangerous for the people who used it.
It was lost in a fire at the company.
qs.q: Why was the invention put aside at first?

options: The pieces of paper kept falling out of the book.
The choir sang badly and the church was very noisy.
The glue was too strong and damaged the pages.
The company closed and nobody bought the glue.
qs.q: What problem did the weak glue finally solve?
In 1968, a scientist ___ (try) to invent a strong glue.
By 1980, the sticky notes ___ (become) a famous product.
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Penemuan itu disimpan."

read.text:
In 1968, a scientist at a company in America tried to invent a very strong glue. Instead, he created a weak glue that stuck to paper but could be removed easily. At that time, nobody knew how to use it, so the invention was put aside.
Several years later, another employee had a problem. He had been singing in a church choir, and the pieces of paper that he used to mark his book kept falling out. Then he remembered the weak glue. By 1980, the sticky notes had become a famous product that people around the world used every day.
read.title: The Story of the Post-it Note
